subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Hub and Spoke Networks
description: A micro-lesson that makes Hub and Spoke Networks usable.

hook.text: FedEx flies every package to Memphis, then back out to its destination. It sounds crazy—but it works.

buildup.text: Hub and spoke routes all freight through central hubs instead of connecting every origin to every destination.

discovery.text: It consolidates volume at hubs, enabling efficient sorting and full-vehicle loads on each spoke.

twist.text: A hub failure cripples the entire network. When Memphis snows in, thousands of FedEx packages are late.

climax.text: Most airlines, parcel carriers, and LTL networks use hub and spoke. It's the dominant freight model.

punchline.text: Go through the middle to reach the edge faster.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of hub and spoke?
